question: The first session of Indian National Congress was held in 1885. In which city of India was it held?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bombay__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The party's foundation in December 1885, Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee became its first president. 
 
• From 1885 to 1933, the presidency had a term of one year only.
 
• It was held on the initiative of retired civil service officer Allan Octavian Hume.
